nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for electric vehicles|Lifecycle analysis of electric vehicles_qna_000
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Why is it crucial to review Life Cycle Assessments (LCAs) for CDR options?
nodes.answer: Reviewing LCAs is crucial because it helps understand the various life-cycle environmental impacts and uncertainties associated with different CDR technologies.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for electric vehicles|Lifecycle analysis of electric vehicles_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the main purpose of the research outlined in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The main purpose of the research is to develop a critical understanding of the employment of digital technologies for LCA studies, focusing on the opportunities and challenges associated with circular strategies.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for electric vehicles|Lifecycle analysis of electric vehicles_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is the purpose of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)?
nodes.answer: LCA quantifies the environmental impacts of products or services throughout their entire lifecycle to support environmental sustainability assessments and circular economy strategies.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for electric vehicles|Lifecycle analysis of electric vehicles_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why is the integration of digital technologies into LCA considered complex?
nodes.answer: It is considered complex because it is still at an early stage of study and implementation.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for electric vehicles|Lifecycle analysis of electric vehicles_qna_004
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is the main aim of the research mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The main aim of the research is to develop a deeper and more critical understanding of the integration of digital technologies (DTs) into Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), focusing on the opportunities and challenges of circular strategies.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for electric vehicles|Lifecycle analysis of electric vehicles_qna_005
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What specific aspects does the research focus on regarding digital technologies and Life Cycle Inventory (LCI)?
nodes.answer: The research focuses on understanding what circular loops are addressed when digital technologies are integrated into the development of a Life Cycle Inventory and identifying the trade-offs involved in this integration.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy for electric vehicles|Lifecycle analysis of electric vehicles_qna_006
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What does Life Cycle Management (LCM) entail?
nodes.answer: Life Cycle Management (LCM) is a dynamic and iterative process that involves engaging various stakeholders. It is informed by Life Cycle Analysis (LCA) data but goes beyond environmental factors to consider economic and social dimensions for a comprehensive approach to sustainable development.
